description:
**Job Title: Customer Success Manager** 




**Location:** 
 Gurgaon
 



**Experience:** 
 4–8 years (D2C/eCommerce/Fashion preferred)
 



  





  





**About Us**




  





 We're looking for an ownership\-driven customer success manager who can run the back bone of customer experience for Oyela. You'll be the single point of accountability and own Oyela's entire post\-purchase customer experience — the team, the process and the promise. You will lead 10 support agents and 2–4 escalation leads, and be the single owner of what a customer hears from us, how fast they hear it, and what happens inside the company when they raise an issue. This is a build role, not a queue\-monitoring role.
 



 This is a frontend driven customer first approach role instead of operational lead.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities:**




  




* **Team \& KRAs:** 
 Define KRAs and scorecards for agents and escalation leads. Run weekly QA audits, coaching, 1:1s, rosters, training, hiring and retention.
* **Ticket lifecycle:** 
 Own the helpdesk stack across WhatsApp, calls, email, Instagram, chat and marketplaces. Define contact\-reason taxonomy, P1–P4 priority, routing, SLAs, reply templates and brand tone — and define exactly what "closed" means, with CSAT on every closure.
* **Internal action triggers:** 
 Map every complaint to the internal team that must act — warehouse, logistics, quality, catalog, finance, marketing — with named owner, TAT and proof of completion. Own the L1–L4 escalation matrix and make sure the customer is updated within the promised window, every time.
* **SOPs:** 
 Write an SOP for every contact reason and every internal trigger, with a time standard on every step. Maintain them versioned, review monthly/quarterly, update on any policy or partner change, and audit adherence.
* **Reporting \& root cause:** 
 Own the leadership dashboard (FRT, resolution TAT, SLA adherence, backlog, CSAT, contacts per order, cost per contact). Run a weekly Voice\-of\-Customer review with ops and product to fix root causes — and bring support volume down, not just response time.



  





**Requirements**




  




* 4–8 years in customer experience/support, with 3\+ years managing a team of 10 or more.
* D2C, e\-commerce, fashion, retail or quick\-commerce background — you know order, delivery, return and refund journeys first\-hand.
* Proven experience building an SOP, SLA and escalation framework from scratch, not just running one.
* Hands\-on with Freshdesk, automations, routing rules, SLA policies, reporting.
* Working knowledge of Shopify order flows, returns and exchanges, RTO/NDR handling, payment gateway refunds and courier escalations.
* Strong in Excel/Google Sheets and comfortable with dashboards;
* Excellent written and spoken English and Hindi, with the ability to write in brand voice.
* Calm and decisive under escalation — able to say no to a customer and push a fix through another department.



  





**What we offer:**




  




* Opportunity to work with one of India’s fastest\-growing D2C fashion brands.
* Ownership and autonomy to experiment and build impactful features.
* Collaborative and growth\-focused culture.
* Competitive compensation with performance\-based growth.

Education (minimum):
